title: Retro NFTs
tagline: A retro NFT's app based on zelda classics and have seemless experience in intergrating my wallet in to it.
description:
The project is my first NFT project but it uses family to connect the wallet and then the user can obtain free NFTs of Link!

The frontend it totally in rewact and because of family's versitility it can use and wallet to connect, I used metamask to conenct.

I think that it's really cool that it's so easy to integrate family into this dapp and advance my future.
how_its_made:
It's made using ERC721 contract to allow users to mint as many link nfts as they want so they can enjoy their link nft. Plus I used family to integrate using wagmi for conencting to contracts.

I also tested my contracts using foundry and built using openzeppelin dependancies for all my code.
